contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return all text after the first literal delimiter, excluding that delimiter but preserving later delimiters. Return empty text when delimiter is absent.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Delimiter is nonempty.
contract.outputRole: text after first delimiter, or empty when absent
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
